value.rationale: Cyclic recognition of one fixed binary necklace is a canonical rotation-closure task; restricting to two runs gives a natural complete family with a nontrivial quadratic state blowup from n+2 for the singleton. The result determines every quotient at every depth and the unique maximizer proportions for fixed input size, which permits exact sizing of DFA-based circular pattern recognizers. This is not merely a small census or arbitrary parameter substitution.
